mentions.name: Womb.FM
mentions.description: A one-page web app that plays white noise, womb sounds, and kitchen range hood sounds to help newborns fall asleep.
mentions.problem: The author's 30-day-old baby would only sleep with the sound of their kitchen range hood, so no soothing sound option existed for that specific noise.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a small one pager that mimics white noise, womb sounds and our range hood. I hope I don't jinx this but works good so far.

Womb.FM - https://www.womb.fm
